name: Faris Ruknuddin
tagline: I turn messy inputs into useful systems.
intro: Backend engineering, applied AI, and the workflows that connect them. From case documents to screenshots to computer vision, I build around a simple question: what can this input become?

featured.title: CaseVault
featured.label: 01 / TRUST
featured.description: A case-document workspace with encrypted evidence, version history, case-level access, and linked audit records.
featured.pipeline: Document → encrypted evidence → searchable case history

featured.title: Omnimate Shots
featured.label: 02 / RETRIEVAL
featured.description: Screenshot ingestion, metadata indexing, and an HTTP search API. Built around file metadata and sidecar data.

featured.title: Communiti
featured.label: 03 / VISION
featured.description: A virtual try-on proof of concept using pose landmarks and 2D garment overlays, with measurement and recommendation experiments.
featured.pipeline: Photo + garment → pose landmarks → visual preview

featured.title: FARIS. Portfolio
featured.label: 04 / INTERFACE
featured.description: My personal portfolio, built with a component-based interface and motion-led project storytelling.
